summary: The appeals arise from land acquisition proceedings by the State Government for the Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation (MIDC) in village Bhoyar, Taluka and District Yavatmal, initiated under Section 32(2) of the Maharashtra Industrial Development Act, 1961. The Special Land Acquisition Officer issued awards with compensation, which was enhanced by the Reference Court under Section 34 of the Act and Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894. The High Court partially allowed appeals by the acquiring body, reducing the compensation. The present appeals are filed by original claimants challenging the reduction. The key issue is the determination of fair compensation, considering sale deeds, land potentiality, location, and price escalation. The Court examined sale evidence, time gaps between transactions, and regional comparables to assess adequacy of compensation.
final_judgment: Disposed of by a common judgment addressing all appeals arising from the same land acquisition proceedings.
